title: Washington State bans octopus farming (HB 1153)
summary: House Bill 1153, sponsored by Rep. Strom Peterson, prohibiting the farming of octopus in Washington State was signed by the governor; the policy takes effect 90 days after signature.
source_title: Octopuses in Washington to remain in their little hideaways beneath the waves, safe from farming. – Washington State House Democrats
notes: Exact signing day not stated on the source page (post dated 2024-03-13 says the bill 'has been signed'). Described by advocates as the first octopus farming ban.

title: California signs OCTO Act banning octopus farming and sale of farmed octopus
summary: Governor Gavin Newsom signed the California Oppose Cruelty to Octopuses (OCTO) Act, prohibiting octopus farming and sales of commercially farmed octopus; over 130 Aquatic Animal Alliance members signed a support letter and ALI gave testimony.
source_title: The Media Celebrates California's Historic Ban on Octopus Farming — Aquatic Life Institute
notes: Bill co-sponsored by Animal Legal Defense Fund and Social Compassion in Legislation (not entities in this dataset). Source is an advocacy organisation's blog.

title: Eurogroup/CIWF case study on environmental risks of Nueva Pescanova octopus farm
summary: Eurogroup for Animals and Compassion in World Farming published a case study on the proposed Canary Islands octopus farm, noting the Canary Islands Government had rejected Nueva Pescanova's simplified environmental impact assessment and required a fuller one.
source_title: Exposing the environmental risks of octopus farming — Eurogroup for Animals
notes: Search results reported that Nueva Pescanova later withdrew its octopus farm plans (SeafoodSource), but that article was blocked (HTTP 403) and the withdrawal and its date were not verified.

title: ALI releases 3rd Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark
summary: Aquatic Life Institute published the third edition of its benchmark of welfare requirements in 8 seafood certification schemes and 1 ratings agency; ASC ranked top (8/10, assessed on its draft farm standard) and RSPCA second.
source_title: 2024 Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark: Aquatic Animal Welfare — Aquatic Life Institute
notes: ASC score from ALI's 2024-10-10 blog post; RSPCA ranking from ALI feed item titled 'RSPCA Ranks 2nd in 2024 Aquaculture Certification Schemes Benchmark' (2024-10-18).

title: First portable in-water shrimp stunner installed in Thailand
summary: Thai shrimp farm Sea Farms became the first to install Ace Aquatec's small transportable A-HSU stunning system for crustaceans, through a partnership with Shrimp Welfare Project.
source_title: Ace Aquatec and Shrimp Welfare Project launch new portable in-water stunning system

title: Scottish Parliament reception on farmed fish welfare
summary: The Humane League UK, Animal Equality UK and The Animal Law Foundation held a reception in the Scottish Parliament on farmed fish welfare, calling for legislation requiring pre-slaughter stunning, as recommended by the Animal Welfare Committee in 2023.
source_title: Parliamentary reception shines a light on forgotten fishes — The Humane League UK
notes: Event date inferred from the article (dated 22 Jan 2025) saying the reception was held 'last night'.

title: Co-op (UK) commits to electrical stunning for all farmed prawns by 2027
summary: UK retailer Co-op stated that all its fresh and frozen prawns are ablation-free and committed to implementing electrical stunning across its whole prawn supply chain by 2027; the policy was developed with support from Aquatic Life Institute.
source_title: Co-op Announces Progressive Prawn Welfare Policy — Aquatic Life Institute
notes: Co-op's own announcement was not fetched; quote is reproduced on ALI's blog.

title: Animal Ask review of fish farming economics in Europe
summary: Animal Ask published a systematic review of the economics of European aquaculture (salmonids, bass and bream, carp), part of a multi-organisation project with Rethink Priorities and Welfare Footprint to guide fish welfare movement strategy.
source_title: The economics of fish farming and fish welfare in Europe — Animal Ask
notes: Publication date from the Animal Ask RSS feed. A companion post on mapping the European farmed fish supply chain is dated 2025-05-01.

title: ASC launches unified Farm Standard with welfare provisions
summary: The Aquaculture Stewardship Council launched its unified Farm Standard in May 2025; Aquatic Life Institute described it as making aquatic animal welfare a central pillar after five years of its engagement with the revision.
source_title: Behind the Reform: ALI's Role in Shaping the ASC Farm Standard Revision — Aquatic Life Institute
notes: Specific welfare clauses of the standard were not reviewed. ASC news (Oct 2026) reports the first salmon producer (Bakkafrost) certified against the new standard.

title: Welfare Footprint paper quantifies pain of trout air asphyxia
summary: A Scientific Reports paper applying the Welfare Footprint Framework estimated about 10 (1.9-21.7) minutes of moderate to intense pain per rainbow trout killed by air asphyxia and modelled the cost-effectiveness of electrical stunning.
source_title: Air asphyxia in rainbow trout slaughter | WFI
notes: Scientific Reports 15, 19850 (2025); DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-04272-1. Exact publication date not shown on WFI page.

title: Shrimp Welfare Project's 21st stunner MOU (CAMIMEX, Vietnam)
summary: Vietnamese producer CAMIMEX joined SWP's Humane Slaughter Initiative, receiving an electrical stunner, with Netherlands-based supplier Seafood Connection committing to prioritise buying stunned shrimps; SWP estimates the programme now reaches about 4 billion shrimps a year.
source_title: Major Milestone for Humane Slaughter: Shrimp Welfare Project Expected to Help 4 Billion Shrimps Annually; New MOU with CAMIMEX, Seafood Connection
notes: Impact figure is SWP's own estimate.

title: Scottish Government commits to official guidance on farmed fish welfare
summary: According to The Animal Law Foundation, the Scottish Government committed in September 2025 to introducing official guidance on fish welfare, after the Foundation argued that the industry Code of Good Practice does not explain how to meet legal obligations.
source_title: OfFISHial Guidance — Animal Law Foundation
notes: Reported by an advocacy organisation; Scottish Government statement not fetched.

title: Bill to ban octopus farming introduced in Chile
summary: Fundación Veg and Congresswoman Marisela Santibáñez submitted Bill No. 17913-12 to Chile's Congress to ban centres or systems for breeding, reproducing or fattening octopod species nationwide, with technical support from the Aquatic Animal Alliance.
source_title: Chile takes a visionary step to protect octopuses and the oceans — Aquatic Animal Alliance
notes: Bill introduced only; passage status not checked. Year of 15 Oct inferred from feed date of the post (2025-10-22).

title: Shrimp Welfare Project named ACE Recommended Charity for 2025
summary: Animal Charity Evaluators named Shrimp Welfare Project one of its 2025 Recommended Charities, the third consecutive year SWP received the recommendation.
source_title: Shrimp Welfare Project Named 2025 Recommended Charity by Animal Charity Evaluators

title: England's Animal Welfare Strategy says boiling crustaceans alive is not acceptable
summary: The UK Government's Animal Welfare Strategy for England stated that boiling crustaceans alive is not acceptable and committed to publishing guidance in 2026 on lawful humane killing methods; Crustacean Compassion and The Animal Law Foundation had campaigned on the issue.
source_title: From a boiling alive ban, to a push for full legal protection: 2026 is the year for decapod welfare — Crustacean Compassion
notes: Source read via WebFetch (curl hit a bot check). Government strategy document itself not fetched. The Animal Law Foundation (AAA blog, 2026-02-11) describes the government as accepting the practice is illegal under existing law.

title: NYC Bar Animal Law Committee endorses federal OCTOPUS Act
summary: The New York City Bar Association's Animal Law Committee released a report endorsing the federal OCTOPUS Act of 2025, which would prohibit commercial octopus aquaculture and restrict trade in farmed octopus in the US; the report cites ALI materials.
source_title: Legal Voices Back Preventive Approach to Octopus Farming: NYC Bar Association Endorses Federal OCTOPUS Act — Aquatic Life Institute
notes: The OCTOPUS Act is a pending federal bill; its legislative status was not checked. NYC Bar report itself not fetched.

title: Bill to ban cephalopod farming introduced in Mexico's Senate
summary: Senator Maki Esther Ortiz Domínguez introduced a reform of Mexico's General Law of Sustainable Fisheries and Aquaculture to prohibit commercial aquaculture of any cephalopod species, led by Fundación Veg with support from ALI and the Aquatic Animal Alliance.
source_title: Four Years of Evidence-Based Advocacy Behind Mexico's Octopus Farming Ban Bill — Aquatic Animal Alliance
notes: Bill introduced only. Web search snippets gave 25 Feb 2026 as the introduction date; not confirmed on the fetched page.

title: Kenya launches national fish welfare SOP for aquaculture
summary: At the 11th Our Ocean Conference in Mombasa, Kenya's government launched the National Manual Standard Operating Procedure for Fish Welfare in Aquaculture (FW-MSOP), described as the first such national framework in Africa; OHDI's AFIWEL programme supported its development.
source_title: From Vision to National Policy: Kenya Launches Africa's First National Fish Welfare Manual Standard Operating Procedure (FW-MSOP) — Aquatic Animal Alliance
notes: Source is a guest post by OHDI on the AAA blog; Kenyan government documents not fetched.

title: Buenos Aires court recognises two goldfish as sentient subjects of rights
summary: A Buenos Aires criminal court approved a pretrial probation agreement recognising two goldfish kept in a sushi restaurant tank as sentient beings and subjects of rights rather than property, in a case brought by Jaulas Vacías under Law 14,346.
source_title: Sentient: An Argentine Court Recognizes Two Goldfish as Subjects of Rights — Aquatic Animal Alliance
notes: Guest post by Animal Interseccional; court documents not fetched. Concerns ornamental (not food) fish.

title: Eurogroup white paper: 'Aquatic animal slaughter: time to make the rules'
summary: Eurogroup for Animals published a white paper examining slaughter practices in EU aquaculture and wild-capture fisheries and arguing for mandatory EU-level standards, noting over 130 billion aquatic animals are caught by EU fleets each year.
source_title: Aquatic animal slaughter: time to make the rules — Eurogroup for Animals
notes: Related Eurogroup publications listed on the page: factsheet on RAS and slaughter (2026-06-04) and policy briefing on fish welfare indicators (2026-04-28).

title: Fish Welfare Initiative scopes expansion beyond India and China
summary: Fish Welfare Initiative said it is seriously considering expanding operations to another country for the first time since 2022, in line with a vision of running cost-effective programmes in multiple lower- and middle-income countries, and began scoping work.
source_title: Our Proposed International Expansion — Fish Welfare Initiative

title: ASC launches Responsible Shrimp Slaughter Project
summary: The Aquaculture Stewardship Council launched an applied research project, supported by Coefficient Giving, to consolidate evidence, run research and field trials, and develop validated parameters and practical tools for stunning and slaughter of farmed shrimp.
source_title: ASC launches project to bridge science-to-practice gap in shrimp welfare
notes: Grant amount not stated on the source page. Builds on a proposed Responsible Shrimp Slaughter Coalition that was never formally established.

title: FWI open call: funding new ideas for farmed fish welfare in India
summary: Fish Welfare Initiative opened a funding call for developing and studying novel field interventions, technologies or actionable research that could become scalable programmes to improve farmed fish welfare in Indian aquaculture.
source_title: Open Call: Funding New Ideas to Improve the Welfare of Farmed Fishes in India — Fish Welfare Initiative
notes: Deadline 18:00 Indian Standard Time. Funding amounts not captured from the summary section.

title: ICAW ranks French supermarkets on shrimp welfare commitments
summary: The International Council for Animal Welfare published 'Souffrance en rayon', ranking 11 French retailers on commitments on eyestalk ablation and stunning before slaughter; four had commitments on both, four on ablation only and three on neither.
source_title: ICAW publishes the first ranking of French supermarkets on shrimp welfare — Animal Welfare Observatory
notes: Reported on Animal Welfare Observatory's site; ICAW (not an entity here) and its report were not fetched directly. Data as of 1 Oct 2026.

title: EU Vision for Fisheries and Aquaculture 2040 commits to farmed aquatic animal welfare framework
summary: The European Commission's Vision for Fisheries and Aquaculture towards 2040 includes a commitment to further develop the EU framework for welfare of farmed aquatic animals at all production stages; Eurogroup notes no timeline or explicit commitment to binding legislation.
source_title: EU Vision 2040: a step towards protection for aquatic animals — Eurogroup for Animals
notes: Exact adoption date of the Commission's Vision not stated on the source page; event_date approximated from source date. Commission document not fetched.

title: FWI retracts two years of farm-programme data from Nellore site
summary: Fish Welfare Initiative reported detecting data fabrication at its smaller Nellore operating region and retracted all data and impact from that region for the previous two years; it said it is considering whether to continue operations there.
source_title: Data Issues and Retraction in Our Farm Program — Fish Welfare Initiative
